object_description: linear compact extension with a smaller side volume
design_condition: The compact extension is aligned with the existing college composition, using the sports hall as a scale reference, raising the classroom building while preserving the established hierarchy and outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The connecting volume takes the size of the sports hall as a reference and is skilfully integrated into the composition.
The raised classroom building retains the main volume hierarchy.
The unitary facade treatment gives coherence and a new identity to the college.
The entrance hall provides multiple access routes and numerous possibilities of use.
The provision of light on each distribution level improves the spatiality of the platforms in a simple but effective way.
The compactness preserves access qualities and as much space as possible for sports and outdoor activities.
The reorganization of sports areas, play areas and paths generates quality gathering places and varied walks.
The treatment of the developments promotes biodiversity and rich, varied local vegetation.

negative.statement: The sanitary facilities in the smaller volume are insufficient, and a group room is lacking on each floor.
The unitary facade treatment still needs clarification in its development.
